scientific_integrity: The scalar smallest-fort size and associated failed zero forcing parameters are not claimed as novel; the asserted contribution is the two complete counting polynomials and structural minimal-fort classification. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: All results concern ordinary forts on J(n,2), not general Johnson graphs. Numerical verification is exhaustive for n<=7 and not a substitute for the infinite symbolic proof. The 2024 directly relevant Johnson-graph paper had abstract-only access, leaving publication-priority uncertainty.
title: Complete fort and minimal-fort enumerators of triangular graphs
